title: If heaven is real…
paragraphs:
If heaven is real…
then this life is only the introduction.

Your career isn’t eternal.
Your money isn’t eternal.
Your body isn’t eternal.

The real question is:
Where will eternity begin for you?
What if this life is just the opening chapter?
If heaven is real… the biggest decision you’ll ever make isn’t your job, your city, or your money.
It’s what you do with Jesus.
If you knew eternity was real, would you live differently today?
